violation_type.title: Water Activities - 1 Caregiver With Each Child Under 24 Months Who is Wading, Bathing, or Swimming (26 TAC §742.807(b))
violation_type.short_title: Water Activities - 1 Caregiver With Each Child Under 24 Months Who is Wading, Bathing, or Swimming
violation_type.typical_finding: The permit holder has allowed children to use two wading pools and a small inflatable pool at the operation without having one caregiver present for each toddler who was allowed to use the pool.
